# Stay Clock: Flip Desk Clock

> Stay Clock turns your iPhone or iPad into an always-on desk clock you can read from across the room. Big full screen time in portrait or landscape, a calendar that fits each face, and one look that follows you to StandBy, the Lock Screen, Home Screen widgets and Apple Watch.

Key features (from the App Store listing):
- Full screen time that stays readable from far away, on iPhone and iPad, in portrait or landscape.
- Keep Awake that understands charging: stay on while charging, always on with a battery floor, or follow the system.
- Panel Care for OLED screens: gentle pixel shifting, details that soften when idle, and a dim red night face on true black for the bedroom.
- One face everywhere: the same face on the full screen clock, StandBy, Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets, and Apple Watch.
- A calendar per face: Off, Simple (date and weekday), or a full Month view.
- App language switching, any city or time zone, 12 or 24 hour time and your own digits.
- Private by design: no account, no ads, no tracking and no network. Everything stays on your device.

Publisher: Lumi Studio
